apps.name: WoW Reader
apps.shortDescription: A private, elegant EPUB & PDF reader built for comfortable Myanmar and English reading.
apps.description: WoW Reader brings your EPUB and PDF library into a clean, distraction-free reading space. Import books once, organize them by title or author, read in immersive full screen, tune typography, use your own Myanmar fonts, and keep highlights, notes and reading progress on your device.

features.title: EPUB & PDF library
features.text: Import books into an app-owned local library and keep reading even if the original download is removed.

features.title: Myanmar typography
features.text: Pyidaungsu and multiple built-in Myanmar fonts, plus custom font import and live display controls.

features.title: Immersive reading
features.text: Edge-to-edge full-screen reading with page or scroll mode, themes, margins, line height and brightness controls.

features.title: Notes & highlights
features.text: Highlight passages, save notes, bookmark pages and return to your saved reading positions.

features.title: Author shelves
features.text: Group books by EPUB author metadata and instantly filter the library to one writer.

features.title: Adaptive library
features.text: Responsive list/grid layouts scale from phones to tablets, foldables and landscape screens.

whatsNew: Added White, Black and Navy Premium app themes.
Made None and Slide page animations behave distinctly.
Smoothed chapter transitions and reduced visible loading/settling.
Imported books are kept as app-owned local copies until you remove them from the library.
Kept author grouping, responsive library layouts and reader display controls polished for daily use.

safety.title: Local-first by design
safety.text: No Google account is required in this release. Imported books and reader data remain on your device unless you explicitly export or back them up.

apps.name: WoW EPUB Maker
apps.shortDescription: Convert DOCX into a compact, beautifully structured EPUB entirely on your device.
apps.description: WoW EPUB Maker is an offline DOCX-to-EPUB builder designed for private, on-device conversion. Choose a Word document, set book details, preserve useful document structure and create an EPUB without uploading the source document to a server.

features.title: 100% offline
features.text: DOCX conversion is designed to run on the device without sending the document to an online conversion service.

features.title: DOCX to EPUB
features.text: Build a structured EPUB from Microsoft Word documents with title and author metadata.

features.title: Document preservation
features.text: Preserves useful page structure, footnotes, Word layout, chapters and fonts where appropriate.

features.title: Optimized images
features.text: Keeps image display size while optimizing assets for a smaller EPUB package.

features.title: Live build progress
features.text: Shows conversion stages and a live build log while the EPUB is being created.

features.title: Read after build
features.text: Open the newly created EPUB directly after a successful conversion.

whatsNew: Preview listing for WoW EPUB Maker v0.2.0.
Download is temporarily disabled while the release build is prepared.
APK will be published only when the release is ready.

safety.title: Offline and private
safety.text: The app is designed for local document conversion. The APK is intentionally not hosted in the App Store repository yet and downloads remain disabled until release.

apps.name: WoW OCR
apps.shortDescription: OCR and AI OCR tools for extracting and editing Myanmar text from document images.
apps.description: WoW OCR is a document OCR app focused on Myanmar text. Import or capture a page image, crop and enhance it, run OCR, switch between image and editable text views, and use optional online OCR or AI OCR providers when configured.

features.title: Myanmar OCR
features.text: Extract Myanmar text from document and book-page images.

features.title: Image tools
features.text: Crop, rotate, convert to black and white, enhance pages and use a document lens workflow.

features.title: Editable text view
features.text: Switch from the source image to OCR text, then copy, paste, clear and align extracted text.

features.title: AI OCR
features.text: Optional AI OCR workflow for improved recognition when a supported provider is configured.

features.title: Optional Cloud Vision
features.text: A user-supplied Google Cloud Vision API key can enable fast online document text detection.

features.title: Themes
features.text: White, Black and Midnight appearance options are available in settings.

whatsNew: Preview listing added to the Whisper Of Words App Store.
Download is disabled while the app is being prepared for release.
APK will be added later when the release build is ready.

safety.title: Coming Soon
safety.text: No APK is hosted for this app yet. The App Store listing is preview-only until the release file is added.
